about_pullquote: I started this because I saw families shivering in winter whilst cowboys charged £400 for a £40 part.
about_para_1: Black Country Plumbing and Gas has been serving Wolverhampton homes and businesses for 18 years. Born from a frustration with overpriced repairs and poor communication, we built the company on honesty and speed. Today we've completed over 2,400 boiler and heating jobs across the region, with a reputation for arriving on time and explaining the problem clearly.
about_para_2: Customers return to us because we charge fairly and get the job done right first time. Whether it's a frozen pipe at 2am or a planned system upgrade, you'll speak directly to the engineer coming out — no call centre, no hidden fees. We're Gas Safe registered and proud members of the local trades community.
reviews_heading: What Wolverhampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Boiler packed up on Boxing Day morning. Called Black Country and they were at the door by 11am. Steve diagnosed a faulty pump, had the spare with him, and we had heat by lunchtime. Charged a fair price too. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: I'd had three quotes for a new boiler from big chains. Black Country came in 15% cheaper and explained exactly what we'd get. Installation was clean, quick, and the engineer walked me through the new controls. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Helen T.

reviews.text: Annual service and safety cert done professionally and without any fuss. They spotted a tiny issue early and fixed it for next to nothing, which probably saved me a fortune later. They're the kind of tradespeople you want to recommend.
reviews.author: Michael J.
